name: Prod.instExistsAddOfLE
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
β : Type u_2
inst✝⁵ : LE α
inst✝⁴ : LE β
inst✝³ : Add α
inst✝² : Add β
inst✝¹ : ExistsAddOfLE α
inst✝ : ExistsAddOfLE β
⊢ ExistsAddOfLE (Prod α β)
decl:
@[to_additive]
instance [LE α] [LE β] [Mul α] [Mul β] [ExistsMulOfLE α] [ExistsMulOfLE β] :
    ExistsMulOfLE (α × β) :=
  ⟨fun h =>
    let ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_mul_of_le h.1
    let ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_mul_of_le h.2
    ⟨(c, d), Prod.ext hc hd⟩⟩
